title: 第九章 能吃第十章 告状第十一章 吃法
content_zh:
韩紫枫看着翠儿问：“我不是叫你打水吗？水呢？还有，如果你喜欢殿下，自己追，不过，你个下人，真的没问题吗？”
翠儿直接下跪说：“小姐饶命，翠儿不是故意的，您饶了翠儿吧。”
紫枫淡定问：“我说什么了吗？行吧，该干嘛干嘛去，对啦，你真有闲心，学学化妆吧，你那个手艺都不如我，是怎么混到贴身丫鬟的。行啦，去忙吧，这里没你事儿。”
翠儿依旧跪着，依旧说：“小姐饶命，翠儿不是故意的，您饶了翠儿吧。”
紫枫翻翻白眼说：“看来我这个小姐，说话没啥用，我不是说叫你去忙吗？你几个意思？行吧，我管不了你，反正主子都在这儿，谁的奴才谁管，犯不着恶心我吧？”
她这话一出，翠儿是起来也不是，不起来也不是。紫枫并没有理会剩下的事情，翻到是看着三皇子，问出一句语不惊人死不休的话：“喂，三皇子，跟你打个商量，你能直接娶我不，拜完堂，直接给我休书就可以，嗯，如果能坚持几天，那就更完美啦。”
北空明被她这么一句，也给搞的有点蒙，他问：“你图啥？”
紫枫淡定的回答：“全部都是字面意思，拉你结个婚，再说白一点，占你几天王妃的位置，然后你随便休，我也就不用犯你啦。爽快一点，不好吗？”
一旁的主母很嫌弃的说：“够啦，小枫，你说出如此不知廉耻的话，有没有想过将军府的颜面。”
紫枫淡定的回答：“主母啊，丫鬟都能推小姐出来拉郎配了，你们但凡要点脸，都不能玩的这么下道吧？难道这个家，不是主母你管吗？”
这就看出，现代人和古代人的区别，现代人的思维，别管行为花不花，嘴上是真吃不了亏，毕竟信息爆炸，那是什么都见过，看过，什么都敢说。可古代人，就算是真风尘女子，也比不上现代的人见的多，见的广啊。
何况紫枫也不是个学习多认真的，大把时间泡吧，那是什么屏蔽的事情都见过的，追剧，那也是必须必的，于是这件事，就直接把这个主母往上面一架，不管啦。
北空明眯缝着眼睛，才想说什么，就听到翠儿依旧重复那句：“小姐饶命，翠儿不是故意的，您饶了翠儿吧。”
他这个皇子都有点无语啦，扫了翠儿一眼，话改为：“将军府的丫鬟，还真是，真是有家教啊！来人，把她拖去安静的地方。”
众人都感觉到，皇子都有点不耐烦了，紫枫啧啧啧的说：“别那么小气吗？”转头说：“老爹，找家丁拖走吧，已经有点碍事了，听不懂人话的，怎么也往府里买，分分钟仇恨就能给拉满啊！”
上官武能说啥，给旁边的管家是个颜色，翠儿就被拖走找地方审问去，没想到，翠儿依旧嘴里喊着：“小姐饶命，翠儿不是故意的，您饶了翠儿吧。”
紫枫直接就跟一句：“不是，这句话的意义在哪里啊喂？”
北空明被紫枫的吐槽，一下说的破功啦，居然笑了起来，可紫枫感觉哪里不对，直接把北空明往上官武身上一推，随后，叫所有人都很诧异的是，翠儿手持一把匕首，居然一刀就扎在紫枫的手臂上。
紫枫毕竟是习武的，用手臂挡致命伤害是本能，只是看着贯穿的伤口，紫枫吐槽：“不是，家里那个这么想不开，这种奴才是咋混进来的啊？这也太草率啦！”
只是眼看见血了，所有人都有点事傻眼啦，紫枫照着翠儿就是一脚，嘴里还说：“你这么草率的刺杀，真的好吗？原本死缓，这次是真的没的缓啦。曹，真疼啊！呜呜呜。”

接下来，一群人就忙活着，一波人去审问翠儿，另一波人找医生，救治紫枫，倒是紫枫，超感兴趣的问：“喂，听说现在外面四处闹灾，都是啥灾？”
北空明叹口气的说：“虫灾，弄的名不聊生。”
紫枫淡定来一句：“虫子？大多能吃的说，那个虫子啥模样的？”
别说，北空明还真见过，不但说，还用紫枫的学，淡定的画，紫枫看一样，顿时咽口水说：“可惜啦，可惜啦，如果没受伤，能吃一顿好的的啊！”
北空明无语，不过还是问：“你有办法？”
紫枫淡定的说：“办法有，但，我只能给办法，具体实践这个活儿，是御厨的。话说，麻婆豆腐这道菜，这边又不？蒜这个调料这边有不，姜，辣椒？”
北空明琢磨一下说：“吧几样东西画出来。”紫枫点头，他继续说：“都有。”
紫枫淡定的说：“首先，要百姓们找铁筷子，或者是铁簸箕，然后，把这些虫，抓起来，把他们的壳上的泥清洗赶紧，最好用刷马毛的刷子给清洗赶紧，接着丢到蒸锅里蒸，加上点姜汁料，干饭就完事啦。皇宫里讲究点的话，可以爆炒，加蒜，姜，辣椒，炒个料汁，让料汁的味道充分吸收进去。一蒸锅，不够一个人造的。”
“对了，可以的话，挖出一个大池塘，把这些虫养殖起来，这些虫是相当好养活的，真繁殖起来的话，以后百姓都不用饿肚子啦，也算一种食物稳定来源。唯一有点不好的是，第一，这种东西必须吃熟透的，不然容易肚子里长虫子，毕竟这种虫的寄生虫还是蛮多的。二，大量繁殖破坏生态平衡，额，就是你们说的虫灾；三这个属于寒性比较重的食物，嗯，后面就不知道啦。去问中医啊！”
北空明再次笑啦，他很认真的问：“你确定这个东西能吃？”
紫枫点头：“老好吃啦，哦对，受伤的人，也不能吃，跟虾蟹是一样的。容易导致伤口发炎的说。所以，需要御厨出手，先研究明白怎么吃，再把吃法交给大家，嗯嗯。如果御厨不掉链子的话，估计一个月，就差不多能吃的不剩下啥啦。哦对，外壳要剥开，吃里面的肉肉哦。”
content_en:
Han Zifeng looked at Cui'er and asked, "Didn't I tell you to fetch water? Where's the water? Also, if you like His Highness, you can pursue him yourself, but you, a servant, are you really okay?"
Tweetie knelt down and said, "Miss, please spare your life. Tweetie didn't do it on purpose. Please spare Tweetie."
Zifeng asked calmly: "Did I say anything? Okay, go ahead and do what you have to do. By the way, you are really free, learn how to do makeup. Your skills are not as good as mine, how did you get to be a personal maid. Okay, go and do your work, you have nothing to do here."
Tweetie was still kneeling and said: "Miss, please spare my life. Tweetie didn't do it on purpose. Please spare Tweetie."
Zifeng rolled her eyes and said: "It seems that my words are of no use as a young lady. Didn't I tell you to go do your work? What do you mean? Okay, I can't control you. The master is here anyway. Whoever is your slave is the one who cares. You can't offend me, right?"
As soon as she said these words, Cui'er didn't get up either or not. Zifeng ignored the rest of the matter, turned to look at the third prince, and asked something that was not surprising: "Hey, third prince, let's discuss it with you. Can you marry me directly? After the wedding, you can just give me a letter of divorce. Well, if you can hold on for a few days, it will be more perfect."
Beikong Ming was a little confused by her words. He asked, "What are you trying to do?"
Zifeng replied calmly: "It's all literal. I want to get you married. To put it bluntly, I will occupy your position as the princess for a few days. Then you can divorce as you please, and I won't have to offend you. Be more relaxed, okay?"
The mistress on the side said with disgust: "That's enough, Xiaofeng, you said such shameless words, have you ever thought about the face of the General's Mansion?"
Zifeng replied calmly: "Mistress, the maids can push the young ladies out to be married to husbands. You can't be so mean whenever you want to save face, right? Don't you, the mistress, control this family?"
This shows the difference between modern people and ancient people. In the thinking of modern people, regardless of whether the behavior is expensive or not, the words really cannot suffer. After all, the information explosion means that everyone has seen and read everything, and they dare to say anything. But people in ancient times, even really promiscuous women, could not see as much or as widely as people in modern times.
What's more, Zifeng is not someone who studies very seriously. She spends a lot of time in bars. She has seen all kinds of censorship. It is also necessary to follow dramas, so in this matter, she just puts the mistress on the top and ignores it.
Beikong Ming squinted his eyes and was about to say something when he heard Tweetie repeating the same sentence: "Miss, please forgive me. Tweetie didn't mean it. Please spare Tweetie."
He, the prince, was a little speechless. He glanced at Cui'er and changed his words to: "The maid in the General's Mansion is really, really well-educated! Someone, drag her to a quiet place."
Everyone felt that the prince was a little impatient. Zifeng tutted and said: "Don't be so stingy?" He turned around and said: "Dad, ask the servants to drag him away. It's already a bit of a bother. If you don't understand people, why don't you buy it from the house? You can fill up your hatred in a minute!"
What Shangguan Wu could say was a sign of trouble for the housekeeper next to him, so Cui'er was dragged away to find a place for interrogation. Unexpectedly, Cui'er still shouted: "Miss, spare your life, Cui'er didn't mean it, please spare Cui'er."
Zifeng said directly: "No, what is the meaning of this sentence?"
Beikong Ming was laughed at by Zifeng's complaints, saying that he had broken his skills, but Zifeng felt something was wrong, and directly pushed Beikong Ming towards Shangguan Wu. Then, to everyone's surprise, Cui'er held a dagger and stabbed Zifeng's arm.
After all, Zifeng is a martial arts practitioner, and it is instinctive to use his arms to block fatal injuries. Just looking at the penetrating wound, Zifeng complained: "No, the one at home is so confused, how did such a slave get in? This is too hasty!"
Just eyesSeeing the blood, everyone was dumbfounded. Zifeng kicked Cui'er and said, "Is it really okay for you to assassinate her so hastily? There was originally a reprieve for death, but this time there is really no reprieve. Cao, it really hurts! Ooooooh."
Next, a group of people were busy. One wave of people went to interrogate Cui'er, and another wave of people went to find a doctor to treat Zifeng. Zifeng, on the other hand, asked with great interest: "Hey, I heard that there are disasters happening everywhere now. What are they?"
Beikong Ming sighed and said, "The insect plague has made us miserable."
Zifeng said calmly: "Insects? Most of them are edible. What does that insect look like?"
Don't mention it, Beikong Ming has actually seen it. Not only did he talk about it, he also used Zifeng's skills to draw calmly. Zifeng looked the same and suddenly swallowed his saliva and said: "It's a pity, it's a pity. If he wasn't injured, he could have had a good meal!"
Beikong Ming was speechless, but still asked: "Do you have any idea?"
Zi Feng said calmly: "There is a way, but I can only give you a way. The specific practice of this work belongs to the imperial chef. By the way, Mapo tofu is not a dish here? Is there any seasoning such as garlic, ginger, or chili here?"
Beikong Ming thought about it and said, "Let's draw a few things." Zifeng nodded, and he continued, "All of them."
Zifeng said calmly: "First, ask the people to find iron chopsticks or iron dustpans. Then, catch these insects, clean the mud on their shells quickly, preferably with a horsehair brush, and then throw them away. Steam it in a steamer, add some ginger juice, and the rice is done. If you are more particular about it, you can stir-fry it, add garlic, ginger, and pepper, and let the flavor of the sauce be fully absorbed. "
"By the way, if possible, dig a big pond and breed these insects. These insects are quite easy to feed. If they really multiply, people will not have to go hungry in the future. It can also be regarded as a stable source of food. The only disadvantage is that, first, this kind of thing must be Eat well-cooked food, otherwise you will easily get bugs in your stomach. After all, there are quite a lot of parasites. Secondly, large-scale reproduction will destroy the ecological balance. Well, it is what you call insect pests. Thirdly, this food is relatively cold, so I won’t know about it later!”
Beikong Ming laughed again, and he asked seriously: "Are you sure this thing is edible?"
Zifeng nodded: "It's so delicious. Oh yes, injured people can't eat it either. It's the same as shrimps and crabs. It can easily lead to inflammation of the wound. Therefore, we need the Royal Chef to take action and figure out how to eat it first, and then leave it to everyone. Hmm. If the Royal Chef doesn't lose the chain, it is estimated that in a month, there will be almost nothing left to eat. Oh yes, you need to peel off the outer shell and eat the meat inside."
